tourer-1915.label: Touring car
tourer-1915.about: Tall and upright on wooden spoked wheels, its engine under a narrow bonnet. A car for everyone, if everyone could crank it.

sedan-1935.label: Sedan
sedan-1935.about: A closed car with a tall grille and wire wheels, its fenders still separate from the body.

fastback-1948.label: Fastback sedan
fastback-1948.about: A rounded postwar sedan, its roof sloping all the way down to the bumper.

hardtop-1957.label: Hardtop
hardtop-1957.about: Two-tone paint, whitewall tyres and tail fins: a car built to be looked at.

sedan-1968.label: Sedan
sedan-1968.about: A full-size sedan, flat of flank and roof, with a vinyl top and room for six.

compact-1985.label: Compact sedan
compact-1985.about: A square little sedan with black plastic bumpers.

sedan-2005.label: Sedan
sedan-2005.about: A rounded modern sedan in the colour most of them come in.

pickup-1975.label: Pickup truck
pickup-1975.about: A truck with an open bed, dented along the tailgate.

beetle.label: Beetle
beetle.about: A round little car with its engine in the back, air-cooled and loud about it.

city-car.label: City car
city-car.about: A tiny rear-engined car you could park sideways.

deux-chevaux.label: Two-horse car
deux-chevaux.about: A light car of corrugated steel and canvas, soft on its springs.

mini.label: Mini
mini.about: A box with a wheel at each corner and more room inside than it has any right to.

cab-uk.label: Taxi
cab-uk.about: A tall black cab, built to turn in the width of a street.

volga.label: Sedan
volga.about: A heavy, rounded sedan of the kind that came with a driver.

lada.label: Sedan
lada.about: A square, stubborn little sedan that could be mended with a hammer.

ambassador.label: Sedan
ambassador.about: A tall, round-shouldered sedan, white, with a curtain in the back window.

kei.label: Kei car
kei.about: A tall, narrow box of a car, exactly as big as the rules allow.

van.label: Minibus
van.about: A van with windows all down its side and its engine under the floor.
